title: Preparation of the sgRNA-Barcode Amplicon Library
author: Shiqi Xie
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pufdntn

steps.title: Perform Initial PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Prepare a PCR mixture using either 1000ng genomic DNA (gDNA) or 100ng plasmid DNA.

substeps.instruction: Run PCR with the following cycles: 98°C for 30sec, then (98°C 10sec, 53°C 30sec, 72°C 3min) for 22 cycles for gDNA or 12 cycles for plasmids, followed by a final 72°C for 5min.

steps.title: Gel Extract PCR Product
steps.instruction: Isolate the 3kb fragment from the PCR products using agarose gel electrophoresis.

substeps.instruction: Run PCR products on a 1% agarose gel, including a vector control in a separate lane.
Perform MinElute PCR cleanup and elute in 2 x 10 µL of EB.

steps.title: First Enzymatic Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the first reaction and incubate at 37°C for 30 min.

steps.title: Second Enzymatic Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the second reaction and incubate at 25°C for 2 hours.

steps.title: Third Enzymatic Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the third reaction and incubate at 37°C for 30 min.

steps.title: Final PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Set up the final reaction and perform PCR using the specified thermal program.

substeps.instruction: Run PCR program: 95°C for 3min, then (98°C 20sec, 60°C 15sec, 72°C 1min) for 16 cycles, followed by 72°C for 3min.

steps.title: Final Library Purification and QC
steps.instruction: Purify the final library and verify the size.

substeps.instruction: Run samples on a 1% agarose gel and excise the band at 400bp.
Run samples on Tapestation (D1000 tape) to check the final library size.
